import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, a, b, c):
        a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)
        assert a.shape == (3,)
        assert np.ndim(b) == 0
        assert np.ndim(c) == 0
        # d = b - c
        self.d = b - c
        # e = a_d
        self.e = a[self.d-1]
